---
name: Feature request
about: Suggest an idea or improvement
title: "[feature] "
labels: enhancement
assignees: ''
---

## Problem

What are you trying to do that Stacy doesn't support today? Describe the
underlying need, not just the proposed solution.

## Proposed solution

What you'd like to see. CLI surface, behavior, or UI sketch if relevant.

## Alternatives considered

Other approaches you thought about and why they fall short.

## Scope check

- [ ] This is a tightly scoped improvement (bug-adjacent, docs, polish)
- [ ] This is a roadmap-level / core feature (please coordinate in Discord
      `#dev` first — see [ROADMAP.md](../../ROADMAP.md))

## Additional context

Links, prior art, related issues, screenshots.
